# Scribe

> Scribe answers questions about philosophy and theory from a library of
> about a hundred and thirty books, and checks every quotation in its answers
> against the page it cites before the reader sees it.

Scribe is a reading tool, not a general chatbot. It searches its own library,
reads the pages it finds, and quotes them. After each answer, every quotation
is looked for, word for word, on the page it names; the reader sees which
quotations were found, which were not, and which could not be checked. A
quotation marked found is in the book exactly as quoted; that does not mean
the answer reads it well.

It does not answer from memory about books it does not hold, and it does not
give out copies of the books.

- [Scribe](https://scribe.socialeating.studio/): ask a question
- [Terms](https://scribe.socialeating.studio/legal/terms.html): plans, prices,
  cancelling and refunds
- [Privacy](https://scribe.socialeating.studio/legal/privacy.html): what is
  kept, who sees it, and for how long
- Source: [scribe](https://github.com/syedi-code/scribe) (this frontend) and
  [alexandria](https://github.com/syedi-code/alexandria) (the library and API)
